wrong_query_pairs.rule: next question in cyclic order over the evaluated questions whose gold sessions are disjoint from this question's (asserted for every pairing)

date_arm_exploratory.rule: emlab.timeparse.parse_question_range (registered), window widened by 3 days, session date = the date in the question's own haystack when the session is there, else the stored date

missing_records_note: Sessions without facts are removed from the facts lists of EVERY question, not only their own: this changes BM25 statistics and removes distractors as well as gold. The direction of the aggregate effect on the facts arms is therefore not known; the 88-question view drops only the questions whose own gold lacks facts and does not isolate the corpus-wide effect.
